The Nine-Rung Study Guide (avalanche.openie.dev) [T/E/M/S · measured_j]

Educational companion to communication-avalanche: labels the 3.8 Ga bio-to-AI rung map as ex-post framing, scopes 45 Lean consent theorems to abstract FSMs & separates Thor 927.3 uJ from desktop us.

1/2 Finite-sample gate counts:
- CTA-E2: 59/60 closed (0/60 drift on N=60); MoL: 44/48; BigCodeBench slice: 29/32
- CTA-E5 5-regime suite: DES-10 solved 98/100 with 1/100 false commit vs <= 49/100 solo camps — gates bound risk by spec coverage, not universal zero

2/2 Biomedical & telemetry boundaries:
- Lean 4 consent filters g_i(s,m)=1 do NOT certify human brain clinical/hardware safety (human BCI is ~15-19 bit/s; CNS EV studies have 0 Phase III trials)
- Thor INA3221 measured_j kept orthogonal to desktop RAPL/IOReport reported_j
